title: WebGL - Web Worker OffscreenCanvas getContext('webgl')
product-requirement: Terminals MUST permit obtaining WebGLRenderingContext via OffscreenCanvas in web workers
specification: Terminals MUST permit a visible BBC application (web worker) to obtain WebGLRenderingContext via OffscreenCanvas object's getContext API ('webgl' context identifier)
assertion: OffscreenCanvas.getContext('webgl') returns a valid WebGLRenderingContext in a web worker

changelog.summary: Initial creation of WebGL context test for OffscreenCanvas in web worker
